meta.name: timeline-report
meta.description: Generate a "Journey Into [Project]" narrative report analyzing a project's entire development history from claude-mem's timeline. Use when asked for a timeline report, project history analysis, development journey, or full project report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目从起步到现在的开发历程整理成一篇叙事报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想回顾项目从零到现在的完整开发历程并写成一份报告
copy.tagline_en: Turn a project's development history into a narrative report
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to retell a project's full development journey as a report

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会从 claude-mem 的时间线读取项目的全部开发记录,产出一份「Journey Into [项目]」叙事报告,涵盖项目起源、架构演变、关键突破、调试经历等章节,并存成 markdown 文件。
howto.when: 当你要求写时间线报告、项目历史分析或完整项目报告时触发;前提是 claude-mem worker 在运行,且该项目已有记录。

say.text: 为 tokyo 项目写一份 Journey 时间线报告
say.note: 先拉取全量时间线并估算 token 消耗

say.text: 分析我这个项目的完整开发历史
say.note: 默认用当前目录名当项目名

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reads a project's whole development history from claude-mem's timeline and writes a "Journey Into [Project]" narrative report covering genesis, architecture, breakthroughs and debugging, saving it as a markdown file.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a timeline report, project history analysis, or a full project report. Requires the claude-mem worker to be running with recorded observations for that project.

say_en.text: Write a Journey timeline report for the tokyo project
say_en.note: Fetches the full timeline and estimates token cost

say_en.text: Analyze my project's entire development history
say_en.note: Uses the current directory name as the project
